tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa chen por phul ba'i zhu yig /

rgyal ba kun gyi rgyal bar gyur na yang*// rgyal ba'i sras tshul rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang*// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid// rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis pa khyod// mes po 'joms byed tshogs bdag ri yi mgon po sogs rnams kyis// khyod kyi zhabs sen zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs skyob ngo mtshar ba// mgon por dang bas mchod pa dag la rjes su 'dod sbyin pa// 'dren pa zhi ba yang dag rig pa rgyal ba de'i drung du// gang thugs mtha' bral rol gnas dbyings su ji snyed shes bya nam mkha'i gling*// mtha' yas bzlums pas rig pa'i sprin skyes snyan ngag nyams brgya'i bde 'thung dbang*// bṛt+ta dzā ti'i skad gsang dang bcas legs bshad yongs lhung dga' ston che// 'dir gnas 'od srung byin gyi do rar skad cig ma nyams smin ma thag /de tshe dngos cag mdongs tha can// rab dga' nyams brgya'i rol gar ni// ci yang brtas pa'i mai na kaḥ |'jo sgeg mchod sprin 'di 'bul lo// mtha' bral chos dbyings dag pa'i rang gzugs ni// rlung gi rgyal mtshan ji bzhin 'gro 'di ko// ma drangs 'dul slad gang gang der snang ba/ /khyod la gcam bu min par nyer sems so/ /'di na'ang nyer 'gro'i khur chen pos// ngal ba'i na tshod gtugs pa yi| |lnga pa'i dga' ston ma mthong tsam// rab zhi'i gnas la brtson lags so// shākya'i rigs las shākya'i dbang po bltams pa ji bzhin du// sā la'i ljon pa la sdang khams kyi rgyal po za ho ra'i| |rigs las rgyal ba mchog khyod legs par bltams tshe mdzes pa'i sku// kā shi'i sleb mos mi len tshangs dang brgya byin gnyid dam shi// bsngags 'os 'bum phrag du ma las// legs 'khrungs khyod sku ku li sha'i// rang bzhin gzhal du med pa dag /e ma 'gro 'di'i bsod nams phul// 'jig rten dbang phyug brtse ba'i bdag nyid yan lag bdun dang bco brgyad chos ldan mkha' ltar rab zab 'dus ma byas// gdul bya dag pa'i yid mkhar 'gog med nges pa lnga ldan rnam rol gar gyis theg chen chos kyi rnga sgra sgrog

/sgrib gsum bag chags sred ldan che ngor sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mkhan de ko sgyu ma'i rnam rol cir yang ston// srid 'dir thub pa'i brtul zhugs mchog mnga' bka' rtags ngur smrig rgyal mtshan sgreng ba'i thub bstan gsal mdzad khyod min su// rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gyi// brda sprod gzhung lugs kun chub cing*// mngon sum rjes dpag sogs rtog ge'i// gnas kun khyod kyis cig car rtogs// gso bya gso byed gso thabs kyis// 'gro ba'i nad sel khyod kho na// yid ngag lus kyis bzo'i 'du byed// sgyu 'phrul ji bzhin mkhas pa'ang khyod// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin dngos po| |bcom pa nang don rig pa'ang de// sgra don gab tshig snyan ngag gzhung brgya gtsug lag skar nag mngon brjod dang*// 'phel dang skyed pa'i sdeb sbyor gnas dang zlos gar brda dag la sogs pa| |smra ba du ma'i yan lag mchog gis lan brgyar btud pa mkhas pa'i mchog /lnga rig paṇa chen ming tsam smra bas mngon sum snang ba khyod kho na// shes dang shes bya'i dngos po kun// ji lta ji snyed thams cad pa// lag mthil a mra'i 'bru bzhin du// ma sgrib dus gsum khyod kyis mthong*// e ma dus gsum kun tu gzigs pa yi// rnam par mkhyen yangs sangs rgyas kun gyi gshis| |babs kyi gnas lugs mnga' khyod rig pa'i lam// brgya stong chub la ngo mtshar phul ci che// gshis babs ji bzhin gzigs pa khyod nyid kyis// ldem por dgongs pas 'dir gnas gyi na ba// rig lam smra ba'i bsngags pa cher spel ba// zol gyis bstod pa snyan ngag rgyan min nam// snyan ngag mkhan dbang dag gis de// bstod tshe mu sar glang chen dang*// phal pa'ang rgyal ltar bsngags pa la// bkag pa med de ma lags sam// phyag rdzogs dbu ma sogs mang yang*// don gyi gnad kar 'khor 'das kun// sems su rtogs na de lags kyi// de de mthong na rdzogs sangs rgyas// de 'dra'i gnas kun ming tsam las// ma rtogs phyir na rgan po bdag

/da dung srid par 'khyam 'di lags// rgyal kun sngon nas thugs kyis dam bcas pa// 'gro kun bu ltar skyong ba nyid yin gyis// de ltar bas na 'dir gnas bdag la yang*// bka' mchid dza h+nu yi rgyun ltar stsol// de skad zhu mchid ngag gi 'khor lo can// drug skyes mgrin pa'i dbyangs snyan dun+du bhiḥ /lha rdzas chu shel mdog 'khur e waṃ gyi// lang tsho gsar pa'i rnam 'gyur stong g.yo ba// pho nya gshog yang zung gi zlos gar gyis// dam pa dang po'i rtsis lugs dgun ra ba// mgo zla gzhu khyim 'khrul med rgya rtsis gzhung*// rnying ma'i lugs bzang dgun tha glang zla zhes// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang gdan bzhi par// 'dod pa'i sa yi dbang phyug zla bar gsungs// nub gling dbus ma lha chen long bu g.yon// sa sde ye shes khams dang rga shi 'char// mtha' 'khob rā ma bza' dang bhi long ci a'i// dmar po'i stong pa dang po rgas mun pa// reg dang e gha 'char ba'i dus dge bar// rab dang gus pa'i yid kyis 'di 'bul lo// swasti pradzebh+yaḥ zhes pa 'di 'bras spungs su rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen por phul ba'o/// / ༈ /dregs ldan kun gyi ral pa'i ri mthon rtser// zhabs sen man shel dag pa rtag bkod tshe// bstan 'gro'i pad tshal rgyas la 'gog med pa// khyod dang shākya'i gtso bo las gzhan min// rgyal kun thugs rje'i ngo bo rtag par brtse// snyigs dus gdul dka' 'dul phyir nyan thos ltar// sgyu 'phrul mchog gi rnam rol la gzhol ba// mgon mchog rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen zhabs drung*// gang de dran zhing dad pa'i zla gzhon gyi// shugs dang 'grogs pas sor bcu'i chu skyes 'dab// snying ga'i do rar lhan cig 'dzum bzhin du// dad pa'i gdung shugs yan lag mchog gi gar// nyi 'og shar du dud pas 'di skad gsol// rgyal sras rnams ni lus can don slad du// gshegs dang bzhugs la ngal ba ci zhig mchi// 'on kyang tshur mthong byis blo'i snang ngo ru// bshul ring 'phye la rdo rje'i sku mchog nyid// ngal ba mi mnga' skad cig yud tsam gyis// ta'i ming tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis// che zhing dregs pa'i rgyal thabs 'dzin de yi// yan lag mchog gi cod pan rtse mo ru// khyod zhabs yid bzhin rin chen bkod do snyam// 'dir gnas rgan po'i yid dbang mai na kaḥ

/rnam 'gyur stong gi rol sgeg gar gyis rtsen// 'on kyang nyi 'og dbus gnas dag pa'i zhing*// bstan dang skal bzang du ma'i 'jug ngogs 'dir// 'dren pa khyod nyid blta zhing dam chos kyi// bdud rtsi'i dga' ston ro la spyod 'dod pas// tsha gdung stong la 'gong ba'i gdung shugs ni// ji ltar rgyal ba yum gyi don slad du// sum rtsen gnas su phyar tshul la gzhol tshe// zhing 'di'i lus can gdung bas yid myos te// rdzu 'phrul stong mnga' maud+gal gyi bu// sbran te myur du gshegs par gsol btab bzhin// bdag lta'i lus can lo zla'i khur mang gis// dub pa'i 'byung bzhi'i mgron khang sgyu ma'i grong*// sems kyi mgron pos spong la nye ba rnams// rgyal ba khyod zhal yud tsam mthong ba'i mod// lnga par gyur kyang yid rab rdzogs sems pas// myur du phyogs 'dir gshegs la gsol 'debs zhes// lus ngag yid gsum rtse gcig smon lags na// de 'bras re ba skong ba'i thugs bskyed kyi// zhing 'dir myur bar myur bar phebs par gsol// de skad gsol phyir yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin// kun bzang rnam rol la 'khu dang 'grogs te// dngos 'byor lha rdzas dkar po dri med dang*// rung ba'i tshos ldan dras shing grub pa yi// sku chos dag dang leb rgan mdangs 'tshob pa'i// rngul gzan rnams la e waṃ zung 'jug gi| |rtags kyis bkra ba rnam par rgyal ba'i lo'i// 'du byed zla ba'i dmar po'i gral tshes ni// dga' ba gnyis par 'bri gung phyogs gnas pa'i// skyu ra'i rigs las shākya'i sras dge slong*// rgan por gyur pas rtse ba dag nas phul// zhes pa 'di rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen por rgya nag tu phul ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
